name: Happy Path — Reschedule Existing Appointment
goal: User reschedules an existing appointment for Employee Only.
constraints: Eligibility mode is 'manage'. User selects 'Reschedule the appointment' and provides valid new date, location unchanged.

phases.description: New appointment date collection and validation.
phases.completionCriteria: User provides valid new appointment date.
User indicates not to change location.
Bot confirms appointment rescheduled and offers further assistance.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
